name: Koi Pond
description: A few koi drifting under the surface that come to circle a resting pointer and dart away when you click.

props.name: count
props.description: Number of fish, up to 14. The first three are always a white koi with camellia patches, a gold one and a dark one.

props.name: speed
props.description: Multiplier for everything in the pond: swimming, turning, rising and the rings.

props.name: curiosity
props.description: Chance, from 0 to 1, that a fish comes over to circle a pointer resting on the water. Each fish decides again whenever the pointer settles.

props.name: seed
props.description: Picks the patterns, sizes and starting places. The same seed gives the same pond.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root, which is relative and clips the pond. Other div props are passed through.

props.name: children
props.description: Content above the water. Clicks on links, buttons and fields stay with them; clicks elsewhere startle the fish.
